outcome: CMV DNA in umbilical cord blood
CMV genotypic distribution (UL55, UL144, US28 genes)
cohort: The study included 1282 mother-neonate paired samples from consenting participants admitted to a hospital in central Taiwan between June 2012 and July 2015.
finding: The prevalence of CMV DNAemia was similar in childbearing mothers and neonates, with their genotypic distribution implying potential CMV infection during pregnancy.
